water_tube.definition: Perforated PVC or bamboo tube (15-20 cm diameter, 40 cm length) installed in the paddy soil to observe subsurface water level below field surface.

translations.hi: पानी का पाइप / वाटर ट्यूब (Water Tube)

water_tube.style_note: Keep technical term 'Water Tube' in parentheses alongside native translation to avoid ambiguity during field inspections.

awd.definition: Water management technique where paddy field is allowed to dry naturally until water drops to 15 cm below soil surface before re-flooding, drastically reducing anaerobic methane formation.
awd.style_note: Always pair with abbreviation (AWD) in all farmer advisories.

carbon_credit.definition: A verified certificate representing 1 metric tonne of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e) reduced or avoided from entering the atmosphere, verified under standards such as Verra VM0051.
carbon_credit.style_note: Transliterated term 'Carbon Credit' is widely recognized across Indian agricultural extensions.

buffer_reserve.definition: A 10% volume deduction of credits withheld in Verra's Pooled Buffer Account to protect the carbon system against reversal risks. This is a volume deduction, distinct from revenue split.

translations.ta: பூல் செய்யப்பட்ட இடையக இருப்பு (10% அளவு பிடித்தம்)

buffer_reserve.style_note: Never refer to buffer as a fee or monetary charge. It is purely a credit volume risk deduction.

baseline_water_regime.definition: The standard pre-project farming practice of keeping paddy fields continuously submerged under 5-10 cm of water throughout the vegetative season, creating anaerobic conditions for methanogenesis.
baseline_water_regime.style_note: Clarify that baseline reflects historical farm practice over 3+ documented years.
